title: Launch hero comparison collage + annotated GIF set for quickstart blog
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce a compact hero collage and a companion set of short annotated GIFs for the upcoming quickstart/changelog blog post. Deliver visuals that make the new onboarding flows and UI improvements immediately obvious to readers and reduce support questions.

Deliverables:
- One launch hero collage (1600x900, editable Figma file) that juxtaposes 'Before' vs 'After' states with 4 discrete callouts (text + subtle arrows/overlays).
- Three modular social-ready crops: social OG (1200x630), small preview (800x450), and screenshot card (1000x400).
- A set of 4 annotated GIFs (looping, <4s each) demonstrating key micro-flows: signup -> first prompt, prefix caching visible, streaming response with function call, and rollout fallback behavior.
- Accessible alt-text and copy suggestions for the blog author.
- Exported asset pack (PNG/JPEG/WebP + MP4 fallback) and a README with naming conventions and usage notes.

Constraints & decisions:
- Avoid including real customer data or any email/tenant IDs; engineers to provide anonymized demo accounts. (Eng request from Liam O'Connor).
- Keep GIF durations short and under 1.5MB each when possible; if fidelity is lost, provide MP4 alternatives and an autoloop web version.
- Visual style must match the new product theme tokens (token names provided in Figma file) and use the approved highlight color 'Teal-60' for callouts to remain consistent with the quickstart docs.
- Single-source-of-truth: build modular components in Figma with boolean variants for Before/After so PMs can flip states without additional exports.

Export specs & file naming:
- hero_1600x900_launch_collage_v1.png
- hero_1200x630_launch_og_v1.jpg
- gif_signup_prefixcache_v1.webm (primary), gif_signup_prefixcache_v1.mp4 (fallback)
- README_quickstart_visuals_v1.md (includes alt text and embed snippets)

Acceptance criteria:
- Collage clearly communicates at-a-glance the product improvement (PM measurement: 5-second clarity test >80% pass in informal review).
- GIFs under target size with legible UI text at 1x scale.
- Figma file has components and documented export slices; handoff link included in ticket.
- Designer and PM sign-off obtained; engineering confirms no sensitive data included.

Notes on reusability:
- Components built to be repurposed for future release blogs and in-console release banners.
- Provide a short recipe for localizing screenshots (layer naming convention + suggested redaction layer).
